C-TAUGHT-RULES.Summary: Teach the record's settled authoring, execution and review rules where an author following the skill will meet them: twenty-nine measured teaching gaps land in `ngrace-spec`, `ngrace-plan`, `ngrace-execute` and `ngrace-reviewer` and their packaged mirror, stated generically in each skill's own voice and structure — not as an appended list. Extend `scripts/check-teaching-surface.ts` so the taught rules are asserted, not described: a sentinel per named section plus one load-bearing token per rule, refusal messages that name the file, the rule and the missing tokens, and a record-token universality scan. Mint the chartered row paying the six tokens ratified for this bundle and reconcile every pin the teaching falsifies, including the skill-footprint pair. No version bump, no CHANGELOG, `examples/` untouched.

Goals.Goal: **The teaching.** Twenty-nine rules, measured across two entries the record holds in both findings layers — eighteen enumerated by the retired finding `F226` (items 1 to 18) and eleven more by the staged entry held at `.ngrace/scratch/staged-findings.md` (items 19 to 29; that file is untracked with one copy: read it, never write it) — land in the four skills at these section homes, woven into the passage an author is already reading when the trap fires, in the skill's own voice, never as an appended list: `ngrace-spec` `acceptance_criteria_anchors` carries items 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 28 (criterion authoring: the named baseline commit, the archive pathspec exclusion with its reason, the applied-archive evaluation state, the module-enumeration mechanics, parsed structural counts, direct exit codes, generous timeouts, producible criteria, both-direction probes, and the firing precondition of the unmapped warning); `ngrace-spec` `clarifications` carries item 15; `ngrace-spec` `workflow` carries item 16; `ngrace-spec` `shape_sources` carries item 19; `ngrace-spec` `status_rules` carries item 29 (a draft `spec.xml` is revised in place; only an approved artifact is immutable and repaired by supersede); `ngrace-plan` `must_do` carries items 11 and 17 (one rule — the `plan new` skeleton seeds are placeholders and the pre-wired `Satisfies` is re-homed deliberately), item 18, and item 12 amended into row 15 in place; `ngrace-plan` `spec_plan_traceability` carries item 4; `ngrace-plan` `command_phase_rules` carries item 20; `ngrace-execute` `execution_rules` carries items 13 and 14; `ngrace-execute` `cursor_kinds` attempt kind carries item 21; `ngrace-reviewer` gains one named block, `review_judgment`, placed between `mechanized_first` and `review_checklist`, carrying items 22 to 27. Both trees change together. Item 28 is taught in the `acceptance_criteria_anchors` sentence it corrects, not beside item 4 in `ngrace-plan` `spec_plan_traceability`, and the reason is on its face: the shipped sentence promises the unmapped warning with no precondition, which is false as written — the warning is produced only against an active `plan.xml`, and the trap fires while a draft spec is authored, when no plan exists and the author reads exactly this passage. The plan-side home is read when the plan already exists, so the precondition holds there and the sentence is true at that reading; item 4 teaches the mapping's consequence (the `--fail-on warnings` trap) to the plan author, a later moment — adjacent, not one rule, which is how the staged entry itself files item 28. Items 12 and 16 (and their restatements) become one generic carve-out each, stated as the product's model with no reference to this repository: an approval write may belong to a party other than the author of the artifact, and a brief may stand in for the interview when the dispatch is cold and has no one to ask.

**The instrument.** `scripts/check-teaching-surface.ts` gains two exported checks and readable refusals. `checkTaughtRules` asserts, per skill and per tree, that each named section home from the teaching Goal exists and that each taught rule's load-bearing token is present inside that section — the granularity is per rule, one stable token each, extracted from its named section. `checkRecordTokens` scans the four skills in both trees for the governed record's tokens under the universality Constraint below. Every refusal path of the runner — the five shipped checks and the two new ones — writes a line naming the file, the rule and the missing tokens before exiting non-zero; the zero-byte refusal measured today is gone. Check mode still writes nothing.

**The row and the payment.** The plan mints the chartered row into `docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/registry.xml` in the house shape: `<Row name="C-TAUGHT-RULES" status="live" kind="chartered">` with an empty `<Number>`, a `<Charter>` carrying the searched-before-minting statement in the house form and no `F` token, `<Pays>` naming exactly `F210 F196 F199 F188 F233 F234` in that order, and a `<StatusText>` naming no `F` token and no `Closed with` sentence. At the close the ceremony's move stamps `<PaidBy>C-TAUGHT-RULES</PaidBy>` and moves the four live findings the first four tokens name, moves the row itself, and flips the four findings' index `Entry` layers in place (the registry genre carries no index `Entry` — measured: zero `genre="registry"` entries in the index, so the move is five moves and four layer flips); the last two tokens mint with zero matching elements until the next flush lands the two staged entries, which retire at that flush — the pre-paid shape. This is a payment for remedies this bundle delivers: the retired finding's eighteen rules and the staged entry's ten are the deliverable, so each token names a defect whose described defect this bundle removes. The plan extends the shipped payer-derivation baseline with the row's six minted tokens — that suite edit is forced by this Goal (measured: the shipped baseline reds on the post-close record), and the row and payment assertions land beside it in the same file.

**The pins.** Every shipped pin the teaching falsifies is repaired to the new true property at the same matcher strength, never weakened and never deleted: the skill-footprint pair (`src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts` line and byte totals, re-measured after the skill edits, never written toward) and the `README.md` measurement cell that test cross-checks; the `ngrace-plan` `must_do` row numbers 15, 16 and 17 keep their numbers and their pinned content (new rows append after 17; rows are amended in place, never renumbered); the falsified-pin set measured at this commit is empty, so `scripts/skill-contracts.test.ts` is a conditional repair, not a forced write. `ngrace-fix` stays at its per-skill pin and the sixteen-skill count holds by non-edit: no fifth skill is edited.

Assertion, decided here: the plan's `TargetAssertions` carry `MustNotContain` for the literal strings (`RM-GOVERNED-PATH` and the seven file names) over the eight skill files, and `checkRecordTokens` carries the pattern classes — any `F`-token, and any `D`-token not immediately preceded by an `RM-` plan id, which is the shipped canonical test's rule extended to both trees. Measured at this commit the scan is red, not green: it flags any `F`-token and `F9.8` sits inside the attempt kind, so the shipped trees are not token-free until item 21's rewrite drops the citation. That red is the honest red-first available to the plan, written into the criterion on its face and not exempted away — item 21 lands, the scan turns green, and its red direction thereafter is planting a token into one tree on a copy. The other measured non-zero hits (`D4`, `D12`, `decisions.md`, the illustrative `C-DROP-LEGACY`) satisfy the named exceptions and never redden the scan, each with its reason above.

**Decided here — instrument granularity.** Per rule, one load-bearing token per rule, extracted from the rule's named section, asserted in both trees; the refusal names the file, the section and the missing token. Why not per skill: one assertion per skill cannot see a rule silently dropped from the section an author meets it in, or moved to the wrong skill — the check would stay green while the teaching went missing where it matters. Why not a full-sentence pin per rule: every rewording of a taught sentence would red CI, and a sentence-shaped needle is satisfied by a mention somewhere else in the file; the token-in-named-section form is the shipped instrument's own shape (the approval-lexicon check extracts the block and demands its needles), the section is the addressable unit an author navigates to, and the wording class stays with the shipped skill-contract pins, which are repaired at their existing strength if the teaching falsifies them. The token per rule is named by the plan, derived from the section-home mapping above.
